name: v1_full_cv_selected
description: Final local GRAPE ablation using full three-stage hyperparameter CV selected X-only configurations.
notes: All metrics are subject_id grouped 5-fold held-out CV metrics.
The CFP/ROI image configs come from x_only_grid_v1 full three-stage hyperparameter CV.
ridge=1e-6 is a numerical stabilization choice.
Linear baselines use no explicit intercept to match the current VCTR design convention.
